examples.en: Each update bumps the node's entry in the vector clock.
examples.zh: 每次更新都会递增向量时钟里该节点的那一位。

situation.en: We use a vector clock per key so replicas can tell concurrent writes from sequential ones.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 向量时钟（追踪因果顺序的逻辑时钟）

examples.en: A Lamport timestamp orders events without trusting wall clocks.
examples.zh: 兰波特时间戳不用信任物理时钟就能给事件排序。

situation.en: For ordering alone, a Lamport timestamp is enough; it cannot detect concurrency, though.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 兰波特时间戳（最简单的逻辑时钟）

examples.en: A logical clock only moves forward when events happen.
examples.zh: 逻辑时钟只在事件发生时才向前走。

situation.en: I would use a logical clock here, because physical clocks drift between machines.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 逻辑时钟（用计数而非时间排序）

examples.en: Clock skew makes timestamp-based ordering dangerous.
examples.zh: 时钟偏移让基于时间戳的排序变得危险。

situation.en: We avoid last-write-wins here because clock skew can silently drop the real winner.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 时钟偏移（机器之间的钟差）

examples.en: If A happens before B, every node must respect that order.
examples.zh: 如果 A 先于 B，每个节点都必须尊重这个次序。

situation.en: The happens-before relation is what we preserve; everything else may be reordered freely.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 先于关系（事件间的因果先后）

examples.en: Causal consistency is the strongest model available partitions can offer.
examples.zh: 因果一致性是分区下可用的最强模型。

situation.en: For a comment feed, causal consistency suffices: replies never appear before the post.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 因果一致性（只保证有因果关系的顺序）

examples.en: Causal broadcast holds a message until its causes are delivered.
examples.zh: 因果广播会扣住一条消息，直到它的前置消息都投递完。

situation.en: We rely on causal broadcast so no replica sees an effect before its cause.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 因果广播（按因果顺序投递消息）

examples.en: FIFO ordering is weaker: it only preserves each sender's own order.
examples.zh: FIFO 顺序更弱：它只保证每个发送者自己的顺序。

situation.en: Per-channel FIFO ordering is enough for log shipping; total order would be overkill.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 先进先出顺序（同一发送者的消息保序）

examples.en: Total order is what consensus buys you, at a price.
examples.zh: 全序正是共识买到的东西，代价不菲。

situation.en: We need total order for ledger entries, so those go through the leader.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 全序（所有节点看到同一顺序）

examples.en: Session guarantees are cheap and cover most user-visible anomalies.
examples.zh: 会话保证成本低，却能覆盖大多数用户可见的异常。

situation.en: We offer session guarantees on top of eventual consistency for the profile service.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 会话保证（同一客户端内的四种承诺）

examples.en: Monotonic reads stop users from seeing their edit, then losing it.
examples.zh: 单调读能避免用户刚看到自己的修改、刷新后又没了。

situation.en: Sticky sessions give us monotonic reads without paying for consensus.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 单调读（不会读到更旧的数据）

examples.en: With a consistent prefix, readers never see effect before cause.
examples.zh: 有了一致前缀，读者永远不会先看到结果再看到起因。

situation.en: Consistent prefix plus monotonic reads is a pragmatic middle ground.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 一致前缀（看到的都是某个前缀顺序）

examples.en: We hash partition by tenant id to spread the load evenly.
examples.zh: 我们按租户 id 做哈希分区，把负载摊均匀。

situation.en: I would hash partition the events; range scans are rare in this workload.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 哈希分区（按键的哈希值分片）

examples.en: A quorum read asks R replicas and takes the newest version.
examples.zh: 法定人数读会询问 R 个副本，并取最新版本。

situation.en: With W plus R greater than N, a quorum read always overlaps the last quorum write.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 法定人数读（读多个副本取最新）

examples.en: A quorum write is durable once W replicas acknowledge it.
examples.zh: 法定人数写在 W 个副本确认后才算落盘。

situation.en: We set W to a majority, so a quorum write survives any single failure.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 法定人数写（写成功要多数副本确认）

examples.en: Quorum intersection is the whole trick behind the safety proof.
examples.zh: 法定人数交叠是整个安全性证明的关键把戏。

situation.en: Safety comes from quorum intersection: any read quorum meets any write quorum.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 法定人数交叠（读写集合必然相交）

examples.en: The leader marks an entry committed after majority commit.
examples.zh: 领导者在多数提交之后才把条目标记为已提交。

situation.en: Majority commit is why a Raft cluster tolerates a minority of failures.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 多数提交（过半副本确认才算提交）

examples.en: The read concern decides how fresh a read must be.
examples.zh: 读关注决定了读到的数据必须有多新。

situation.en: For billing reads we set the read concern to majority; reports can stay local.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 读关注（MongoDB 的读一致性档位）

examples.en: A stronger write concern trades latency for durability.
examples.zh: 更强的写关注用延迟换持久性。

situation.en: I would raise the write concern for orders and relax it for view counters.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 写关注（MongoDB 的写确认档位）

examples.en: Tunable consistency lets each operation pick its own guarantee.
examples.zh: 可调一致性让每个操作自己选保证档位。

situation.en: We offer tunable consistency: carts are eventual, payments are quorum-backed.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 可调一致性（按操作选档位）

examples.en: Linearizability makes a cluster behave like one perfect copy.
examples.zh: 线性一致性让集群表现得像一个完美的单副本。

situation.en: If the interview asks for the strongest guarantee, that is linearizability.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 线性一致性（最强的单对象一致性模型）

examples.en: Serializability means the result equals some one-by-one execution.
examples.zh: 可串行化意味着结果等价于某种逐个执行。

situation.en: We need serializability for inventory, even if it costs throughput.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 可串行化（事务隔离的黄金标准）

examples.en: Under snapshot isolation, a transaction reads one frozen snapshot.
examples.zh: 在快照隔离下，一个事务读的是一张冻结的快照。

situation.en: Snapshot isolation prevents read skew, but write skew can still slip through.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 快照隔离（读一个一致快照）

examples.en: Optimistic concurrency control validates at commit instead of locking early.
examples.zh: 乐观并发控制在提交时验证，而不是提前加锁。

situation.en: Conflicts are rare here, so optimistic concurrency control beats locking.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 乐观并发控制（先做后验冲突）

examples.en: Two-phase locking guarantees serializability but invites deadlocks.
examples.zh: 两阶段锁能保证可串行化，但容易引来死锁。

situation.en: Classic two-phase locking is correct, yet too costly for our latency budget.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 两阶段锁（先全加锁、再全释放）

examples.en: A distributed lock without fencing tokens is a footgun.
examples.zh: 没有栅栏令牌的分布式锁就是个坑。

situation.en: I would avoid a hand-rolled distributed lock and use the database instead.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 分布式锁（跨节点互斥）

examples.en: Lease-based locking self-heals when the holder crashes.
examples.zh: 基于租约的锁在持有者崩溃后能自愈。

situation.en: We use lease-based locking with a fencing token checked on every write.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 基于租约的锁（带过期的锁）

examples.en: A randomized election timeout prevents split votes.
examples.zh: 随机化的选举超时能防止选票分散。

situation.en: Tuning the election timeout balances failover speed against flapping.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 选举超时（触发新一轮选举的计时）
